name: Chilli
description: Crucial commercial spice and cash crop in India (major producer & exporter, notably Guntur, Warangal, and Byadgi belts). Highly susceptible to the sucking pest complex (thrips, mites) causing leaf curl, and fungal anthracnose fruit rot.
climate: Warm tropical and subtropical climate; thrives in sunny days and warm nights.

soil.drainage_requirement: Very sensitive to standing water; waterlogging triggers phytophthora root rot and massive flower shedding.
soil.organic_matter_requirement: Medium to High (>0.6% OC); incorporate 20 tonnes/ha farmyard manure.

seed_rate_per_ha: 200-250 g/ha for F1 hybrids; 1.0 kg/ha for varieties.

growth_stages.description: Seed germination and seedling growth in nursery beds or portrayed plugs.
Plant branching, sympodial bud initiation, dense foliage canopy creation.
critical_activities: Yellow and blue sticky traps installation (20 traps/acre)

growth_stages.description: Continuous blooming cycles and young green pod elongation.
critical_activities: NAA 10 ppm spray to curb premature flower drop
Split potash application for pungency and capsaicin

growth_stages.description: Pod color change from dark green to deep shining crimson red; multi-stage pickings.
critical_activities: Timely plucking to prevent over-ripeness and fungal rot
Drying on cement threshing floor or solar dryer

irrigation.frequency_days: Every 5-7 days in winter, every 3-4 days in summer

nutrients.basal_application: Full P2O5 (60 kg) + 30 kg N + 30 kg K2O at land preparation.
top_dressing_schedule: 30 kg N + 30 kg K2O at 60 DAT (first flowering)
30 kg N in two splits during multiple harvest flushes
micronutrient_requirements: Foliar spray of 0.2% Zinc sulphate + 0.1% Borax at 45 and 60 DAT

maturity_indices: Firm, dark green pods for green chilli market
Deep uniform red pods with 70-80% red coloration for dry red chilli
harvesting.average_yield_per_ha: 10-15 t/ha green chilli or 2.5-3.5 t/ha dry red chilli
harvesting.post_harvest_care: Sun dry red chillies for 10-15 days until moisture drops below 10%; store in cool, dry place to prevent aflatoxin.
